speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To help me understand your condition, please tell me your gestational age and whether you were born premature. Also, when did the breathing difficulty first start?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity.

Please confirm if there are any signs of grunting, nasal flaring, or retractions, and have a Chest_X-Ray performed to visualize the characteristic ground-glass appearance.
